name: Inventory Report
report_script:
# Inventory Report - Compare Stock Reconciliation between two periods
# Time window: previous day 21:00 ~ target_date 12:00

filters = filters or {}

from_date = (filters.get("from_date") or "")
to_date = (filters.get("to_date") or "")
companies = filters.get("company") or []

columns = [
    {"label": "Company", "fieldname": "company", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Company", "width": 200},
    {"label": "Item Code", "fieldname": "item_code", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Item", "width": 140},
    {"label": "Item Name", "fieldname": "item_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200},
    {"label": "Warehouse", "fieldname": "warehouse", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Warehouse", "width": 180},
    {"label": "From Period Qty", "fieldname": "from_qty", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "To Period Qty", "fieldname": "to_qty", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Qty Difference", "fieldname": "qty_diff", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Stock UOM", "fieldname": "stock_uom", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "UOM", "width": 100},
    {"label": "From Qty (Sales UOM)", "fieldname": "from_qty_sales", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "To Qty (Sales UOM)", "fieldname": "to_qty_sales", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Diff (Sales UOM)", "fieldname": "qty_diff_sales", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "Sales UOM", "fieldname": "sales_uom", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "UOM", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Conversion Factor", "fieldname": "conversion_factor", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 120},
    {"label": "From Recon", "fieldname": "from_recon", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Stock Reconciliation", "width": 180},
    {"label": "To Recon", "fieldname": "to_recon", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Stock Reconciliation", "width": 180},
    {"label": "PR Qty", "fieldname": "pr_qty_stock", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
    {"label": "PR Qty (Sales UOM)", "fieldname": "pr_qty_sales", "fieldtype": "Float", "width": 130},
]

result = []

if from_date and to_date:
    # Build company condition
    company_condition = ""
    query_params = {}
    
    if companies and len(companies) > 0:
        if isinstance(companies, str):
            companies = [companies]
        placeholder_list = []
        for i in range(len(companies)):
            param_name = "company_" + str(i)
            placeholder_list.append("%(" + param_name + ")s")
            query_params[param_name] = companies[i]
        placeholders = ", ".join(placeholder_list)
        company_condition = "AND sr.company IN (" + placeholders + ")"
    
    # Calculate time window for from_date: (from_date - 1) 21:00 ~ from_date 12:00
    from_date_str = str(from_date)
    from_prev_day = str(frappe.utils.add_days(from_date_str, -1))
    from_window_start = from_prev_day + " 21:00:00"
    from_window_end = from_date_str + " 12:00:00"
    
    query_params["from_window_start"] = from_window_start
    query_params["from_window_end"] = from_window_end
    
    from_sql = """
        SELECT * FROM (
            SELECT
                sr.company,
                sr.name AS recon_name,
                sri.item_code,
                sri.warehouse,
                sri.qty,
                i.item_name,
                i.stock_uom,
                i.sales_uom,
                COALESCE(ucd.conversion_factor, 1) AS conversion_factor,
                CONCAT(sr.posting_date, ' ', sr.posting_time) AS posting_datetime,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY sr.company, sri.item_code, sri.warehouse
                    ORDER BY sr.posting_date DESC, sr.posting_time DESC, sr.modified DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM `tabStock Reconciliation` sr
            INNER JOIN `tabStock Reconciliation Item` sri ON sri.parent = sr.name
            LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sri.item_code
            LEFT JOIN `tabUOM Conversion Detail` ucd ON ucd.parent = sri.item_code AND ucd.uom = i.sales_uom
            WHERE sr.docstatus = 1
              AND CONCAT(sr.posting_date, ' ', sr.posting_time) >= %%(from_window_start)s
              AND CONCAT(sr.posting_date, ' ', sr.posting_time) <= %%(from_window_end)s
              %s
        ) ranked
        WHERE ranked.rn = 1
    """ % company_condition
    
    from_rows = frappe.db.sql(from_sql, query_params, as_dict=True)
    from_data = {}
    for row in from_rows:
        key = row["company"] + "|||" + row["item_code"] + "|||" + row["warehouse"]
        from_data[key] = row
    
    # Calculate time window for to_date: (to_date - 1) 21:00 ~ to_date 12:00
    to_date_str = str(to_date)
    to_prev_day = str(frappe.utils.add_days(to_date_str, -1))
    to_window_start = to_prev_day + " 21:00:00"
    to_window_end = to_date_str + " 12:00:00"
    
    query_params["to_window_start"] = to_window_start
    query_params["to_window_end"] = to_window_end
    
    to_sql = """
        SELECT * FROM (
            SELECT
                sr.company,
                sr.name AS recon_name,
                sri.item_code,
                sri.warehouse,
                sri.qty,
                i.item_name,
                i.stock_uom,
                i.sales_uom,
                COALESCE(ucd.conversion_factor, 1) AS conversion_factor,
                CONCAT(sr.posting_date, ' ', sr.posting_time) AS posting_datetime,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY sr.company, sri.item_code, sri.warehouse
                    ORDER BY sr.posting_date DESC, sr.posting_time DESC, sr.modified DESC
                ) AS rn
            FROM `tabStock Reconciliation` sr
            INNER JOIN `tabStock Reconciliation Item` sri ON sri.parent = sr.name
            LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = sri.item_code
            LEFT JOIN `tabUOM Conversion Detail` ucd ON ucd.parent = sri.item_code AND ucd.uom = i.sales_uom
            WHERE sr.docstatus = 1
              AND CONCAT(sr.posting_date, ' ', sr.posting_time) >= %%(to_window_start)s
              AND CONCAT(sr.posting_date, ' ', sr.posting_time) <= %%(to_window_end)s
              %s
        ) ranked
        WHERE ranked.rn = 1
    """ % company_condition
    
    to_rows = frappe.db.sql(to_sql, query_params, as_dict=True)
    to_data = {}
    for row in to_rows:
        key = row["company"] + "|||" + row["item_code"] + "|||" + row["warehouse"]
        to_data[key] = row
    

    # Query Purchase Receipt data within the time range
    # Time window: from_date (prev day 21:00 ~ 12:00) to to_date (prev day 21:00 ~ 12:00)
    # We sum all PRs within from_window_start to to_window_end
    pr_sql = """
        SELECT
            pri.item_code,
            i.item_name,
            i.stock_uom,
            i.sales_uom,
            COALESCE(ucd.conversion_factor, 1) AS conversion_factor,
            SUM(pri.qty) AS total_qty
        FROM `tabPurchase Receipt` pr
        INNER JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri ON pri.parent = pr.name
        LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON i.name = pri.item_code
        LEFT JOIN `tabUOM Conversion Detail` ucd ON ucd.parent = pri.item_code AND ucd.uom = i.sales_uom
        WHERE pr.docstatus = 1
          AND CONCAT(pr.posting_date, ' ', pr.posting_time) >= %%(from_window_start)s
          AND CONCAT(pr.posting_date, ' ', pr.posting_time) <= %%(to_window_end)s
          %s
        GROUP BY pri.item_code
    """ % company_condition.replace("sr.company", "pr.company")
    
    pr_rows = frappe.db.sql(pr_sql, query_params, as_dict=True)
    pr_data = {}
    for row in pr_rows:
        pr_data[row["item_code"]] = row
    
    # Merge data - use string keys to avoid tuple unpacking
    all_keys = set(from_data.keys()) | set(to_data.keys())
    
    for key in all_keys:
        # Parse key back to components using split
        key_parts = key.split("|||")
        company = key_parts[0]
        item_code = key_parts[1]
        warehouse = key_parts[2]
        
        from_info = from_data.get(key, {})
        to_info = to_data.get(key, {})
        
        from_qty = from_info.get("qty", 0) or 0
        to_qty = to_info.get("qty", 0) or 0
        qty_diff = to_qty - from_qty
        
        # Get conversion factor (use 1 if not found)
        conversion_factor = from_info.get("conversion_factor") or to_info.get("conversion_factor") or 1
        if conversion_factor == 0:
            conversion_factor = 1
        
        # Calculate quantities in sales UOM (stock qty / conversion_factor = sales qty)
        from_qty_sales = from_qty / conversion_factor
        to_qty_sales = to_qty / conversion_factor
        qty_diff_sales = qty_diff / conversion_factor
        
        result.append({
            "company": company,
            "item_code": item_code,
            "item_name": from_info.get("item_name") or to_info.get("item_name") or "",
            "warehouse": warehouse,
            "from_qty": from_qty,
            "to_qty": to_qty,
            "qty_diff": qty_diff,
            "stock_uom": from_info.get("stock_uom") or to_info.get("stock_uom") or "",
            "sales_uom": from_info.get("sales_uom") or to_info.get("sales_uom") or "",
            "conversion_factor": conversion_factor,
            "from_qty_sales": from_qty_sales,
            "to_qty_sales": to_qty_sales,
            "qty_diff_sales": qty_diff_sales,
            "from_recon": from_info.get("recon_name", ""),
            "to_recon": to_info.get("recon_name", ""),
            "pr_qty_stock": pr_data.get(item_code, {}).get("total_qty", 0) or 0,
            "pr_qty_sales": (pr_data.get(item_code, {}).get("total_qty", 0) or 0) / conversion_factor,
        })
    
    # Sort by company, then by absolute qty_diff descending
    result.sort(key=lambda x: (x["company"], -abs(x["qty_diff"])))

data = columns, result
